generated.details: Far-left translucent ivory sheers hang in loose vertical folds from a slim window rod, with stitched hems.
The mid-right floor lamp stands between the tables, its slender stem connecting a weighted round foot to a plain linen shade.

Against the far-right wall, a separate wooden side table holds the partially assembled abstract-color puzzle: flat cardboard pieces interlock through tabs and sockets, with loose pieces beside the unfinished edge, without text or faces.
Directly above it, a small carved-wood relief has shallow geometric recesses cut into a solid wall-mounted panel.
